turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

You asked for this meeting, Hale, so I'm assuming you have something more than a computer's opinion. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, so tell me who decided this and on what basis.
Thanks for coming in. The zero went in before I called you, and that was wrong.
I will remove the zero tomorrow morning. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch on Thursday. Nothing goes on his record. I will put all of that in an email to you tonight.

The zero off tomorrow morning and nothing on his record, I'm writing both of those down. What I haven't heard is why Owen should rewrite an essay he already wrote, so what else do you have besides the checker?
Yes, all of it, in writing tonight.
That's not what I asked, Hale. If there's no document behind this, there's no rewrite, and the zero simply comes off.
Okay, I think that is the end of the meeting. Thank you.

Not quite, Hale. The zero comes off tomorrow morning and nothing goes on his record, but the rewrite on Thursday is still open, and without a document there isn't one. Either show me what you have, or your email tonight says the zero is withdrawn, full stop.
